iteration_policy: Development-only compatibility plan for workflow v1.3. Reuses the previously inspected default-ledger matrix; unknown executor outcomes and committed-receipt recovery are separate integration checks. Preserve v1 artifacts and v2/v3 plans. No new formal or preregistered effectiveness result is implied.
claim_scope: deterministic protocol evaluation of request creation, response validation, revalidation and simulated execution on scripted responders in three synthetic families; no LLM, user-study, real identity, concurrency or production-execution claim is allowed

preregistered_hypotheses.H1_proposed_no_incorrect_or_duplicate_ex: the proposed workflow executes no action binding more often than the specification allows, across all 75 scenarios
preregistered_hypotheses.H2_proposed_completes_every_valid_interv: every scenario whose specification expects completion completes under the proposed workflow, so valid interventions are not escalated unnecessarily
preregistered_hypotheses.H3_every_check_is_load_bearing: switching off any single check yields at least one incorrect execution, duplicate execution or wrongly accepted response
preregistered_hypotheses.H4_naive_resume_is_exploitable: the naive resume-on-approval loop executes at least one action the specification forbids
